search_text: published ZDI-08-027 ZDI-CAN-088 CA BrightStor ARCserve Backup caloggerd Arbitrary File Writing Vulnerability 2008-05-19 CVE-2008-2241 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2008-2241 ['Computer Associates'] ['BrightStor ARCserve Server'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Computer Associates ARCserve Backup. Authentication is not required exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the caloggerd log daemon during the processing of log messages that contain directory traversal modifiers. A lack of sanity checking on the provided path allows attackers to append arbitrary data to a file of their choosing and can easily result in a full system compromise. title: CA BrightStor ARCserve Backup caloggerd Arbitrary File Writing Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Computer Associates ARCserve Backup. Authentication is not required exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the caloggerd log daemon during the processing of log messages that contain directory traversal modifiers. A lack of sanity checking on the provided path allows attackers to append arbitrary data to a file of their choosing and can easily result in a full system compromise.
